structural.claim: (a) the 12 guideline and 4 principle nodes are WCAG groupings, not knowledge/guidelines/*.md or brain/principles.json
structural.proof: _build_kg_explorer.py:109 PRINCIPLE = {'1':'perceivable','2':'operable','3':'understandable','4':'robust'}; inside extract_extra section B the ids are minted at 274-282: g = '.'.join(sc.split('.')[:2]); p = PRINCIPLE.get(sc.split('.')[0]); add('guideline:'+g), add('principle:'+p), both from sc_rules() which globs knowledge/compliance/rules/*.json only. grep 'brain' over the whole builder returns ZERO hits; grep 'guidelines' returns only the family-label string and the docstring. Re-extraction yields exactly 12 guideline and 4 principle nodes. (Two citation slips in A: PRINCIPLE is at line 109, not '~140', and the derivation is at 274-282, not '279-283'.)

verdict: A and B are mostly sound and one is load-bearingly wrong. Of 65 numeric claims re-run, 53 reproduce exactly and 12 fail: A's '97 rulings mention token' (84), '17 rulings mention icons' (14), the compliance EXAMPLE-file parenthetical (the file is not in rules/), the token-file ranking (four larger files omitted), the 158-vs-160 arithmetic, and the claim that every roles.json provider carries a `when` (81 of 108); B's slots capability 95/34 (measured 99/35), provenance components 63 (measured 77), tokens-block keys 1014 (measured 1141), antiPattern name pairs 151/97 (measured 153/98), '8 dangling id-shaped strings' (7 rule-shaped + 3 unreported non-rule strings), and usesIcon '4/137 metas name an icon SVG path' (measured 19) — that last one is a below-threshold dismissal resting on a count 4.75x too low. The whole graph_today block of A reproduces to the node, edge and type — 890/1267/1941/3605 and every histogram — and B's headline component measurements (137 corpus, 116/31/38 citations, 834 vs 826 SC pairs with 9+1 residue, 69/26 when-pairs, 154/57/23 type classes, 87/33 behaviour, 735/135 antiPatterns, 345/124 variants, 48/38 binds, 30/13 motion, 26/26 answers/shape, 24/24 provides) are exact. Of 133 evidence items, 107 are verbatim at the cited line, 22 are content-true with a wrong line number or an unmarked elision, 4 are the lane's own prose wearing a file:line 0/1 costume, and ZERO are fabricated quotations. Structurally: (a) (b) (d) (f) HOLD on re-derivation from the extractor source and a fresh recompute; (e) FAILS; (c) is half-false — 470 is right, but knowledge/_build_consult_index.py:53 and knowledge/_build_instrument_fit.py:60 both load _rules-index.json today, so 'nothing consumes it' must not reach Dave. Trust A's graph census and its file-level inventories; re-check A's ruling-mention counts, its roles `when` claim and its 'no consumer' claim, and B's usesIcon dismissal, before any of it is priced.
